name: Way Too Overthinker
description:
Loves to get lost in thoughts,

Can spend hours sitting in one spot, 
Thinking the mysteries all around.
A strange object also seems to be lost, just spinning around.

Not out to prove anything or share beliefs, just a lonely dreamer, thinking about the forever dreams.
